verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's feature docs clearly cover booking caps, letting users limit meetings per day, week, and month. Related time-protection features include budgeting time via calendar events and nudging bookings next to existing meetings to reduce fragmentation, but none of these are the other controls the story names. Missing for 10: buffers before and after meetings, minimum notice, date-range booking windows, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
